detailed_rationale:
UTL Solar (Fujiyama Power Systems Ltd, operating under the 'UTL Solar' and 'Fujiyama Solar' brands with over 29 years of legacy) manufactures rooftop solar solutions across on-grid, off-grid and hybrid categories, alongside solar panels, multiple inverter types, and lead-acid/lithium-ion batteries -- a broader, more diversified rooftop-solar-ecosystem play than a pure module or cell manufacturer. FY26 (year to March 2026) revenue rose 85% YoY to Rs 901 crore and net profit rose 108% YoY to Rs 106 crore, continuing a strong multi-year run (5-year profit CAGR ~72.8%, ROE ~36.4%). The company pays no dividend despite consistent profitability, consistent with continued reinvestment in a still-scaling business.

The residential/rooftop solar segment UTL Solar serves benefits from India's rooftop solar policy push (central-government subsidy schemes for household rooftop solar adoption), a distinct demand driver from the utility-scale/DCR-linked module manufacturing dynamics affecting peers like EMMVEE, Saatvik and Waaree. No order-book figure was available in the sources reviewed, and CRISIL updated the company's credit rating in May-2026 (specific outcome not captured in the sources reviewed) -- a gap worth noting rather than glossing over.
recommendation_rationale: Quant already rates this Hold on both horizons (final scores 79.8/74.5, among the stronger 1-year scores in this batch); the underlying growth and returns (ROE ~36%) are genuinely excellent, but the very high multi-year growth rate is unlikely to be a clean run-rate forever, and the lack of visible order-book disclosure limits confidence in a stronger call.
summary: UTL Solar (Fujiyama Power Systems) makes rooftop solar equipment -- panels, inverters, batteries and full systems -- for India's residential and small-commercial solar market, and has grown very fast and very profitably over several years. It does not pay a dividend, reinvesting instead in growth. We rate it a Hold: strong execution and returns, but very high growth rates rarely continue indefinitely, and forward order visibility was not available to independently verify from the sources reviewed.
positive_para: A diversified rooftop-solar-ecosystem product line (panels, inverters, batteries, full systems) under an established, nearly 30-year brand gives UTL Solar broader exposure to India's residential solar adoption push than a single-product manufacturer, and returns on capital (ROE ~36%) are genuinely excellent alongside a multi-year track record of fast, profitable growth.
negative_para: 85%+ annual revenue growth and a 72.8% five-year profit CAGR are exceptional rates that become mathematically harder to sustain as the revenue base grows, and the absence of visible order-book disclosure in the sources reviewed makes forward revenue visibility harder to independently verify than for peers who publish GW-scale order books.
reverse_dcf_judgment: Specific current-market-cap/PE figures were not clearly available in the sources reviewed for this pass, but against ROE of ~36% and a multi-year profit CAGR near 73%, the business quality is genuinely high; the honest calibration question is how much of that pace is repeatable as the company scales rather than whether the underlying franchise is sound, which it appears to be. Call: quality franchise; fair value assuming continued (but decelerating from peak) growth.
